name: Project 1 Home SOC - detection coverage
description: Techniques emulated in the lab and detected in Elastic. T1059.001, T1136.001 and T1053.005: Atomic Red Team against CLIENT01, Sigma rules, host telemetry. T1071.001: custom beacon simulation, Suricata and Zeek network telemetry. Green = detection validated against lab telemetry, with an incident report.

techniques.comment: IR-2026-001. Encoded PowerShell: alias-aware regex plus WmiPrvSE.exe parent clause. Sysmon EID 1.
IR-2026-002. Local account creation: Security 4720 (primary) plus Sysmon net.exe /add.
IR-2026-003. Scheduled task: Security 4698 (primary, both schtasks and PowerShell cmdlet routes) plus Sysmon schtasks /create.

IR-2026-004. Simulated HTTP beacon (30 requests, ~60 s, jitter): Suricata signature (sid 1000001) and Zeek http/conn telemetry on ELK01. Interval-regularity detection is a hunt script over Zeek conn.log, not a SIEM rule; threshold supported by one beacon and five baseline pairs.
